name: ButtonDock
description: A fixed-position bottom action bar for primary and secondary actions. Commonly used at the bottom of forms, modals, or pages to dock action buttons.

notes: The primary action button should be the first in tab order.
Actions are passed as ReactNode so consumers control the button semantics.

primaryAction.description: The primary action button (typically a full-width Button).

secondaryAction.description: A secondary action button rendered below the primary action.

dismissAction.description: A dismiss/cancel link rendered below the secondary action.

position.description: Controls whether the dock is fixed to the viewport or sticky within its scroll container.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root element.

do: Use for forms with a submit and cancel action at the bottom.
Use sticky when the dock should scroll with a container.
Ensure the primary action is always provided.
dont: Do not nest multiple ButtonDocks on the same page.
Do not use for navigation — use a toolbar or nav bar instead.
